originalInput.name: Workshop care
originalInput.goal: Prepare an eight-week maintenance checklist without silently skipping month-end work.

tasks.description: Every morning, inspect the workbench for loose debris.
Once a week, clean the dust collector filter.
Once per month, check the fire extinguisher gauge.
Every three months, inspect the electrical cable insulation.
